question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Fall out (with)"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: झगड़ा होना, घटना
English Meaning: To quarrel with, to happen
📝 Sentence Example:"We should not fall out with them without any rhyme or reason."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Fall + Out -> बात करते-करते 'बाहर गिर' (Fall out) पड़े क्योंकि झगड़ा हो गया।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Fall through"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: असफल होना
English Meaning: To fail
📝 Sentence Example:"The plans fell through due to your misdemeanour."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Fall + Through -> प्लान छत के 'आर-पार गिर' (Fall through) गया मतलब असफल (Fail) हो गया।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Feel like"?
options: To be excited to do something
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: किसी काम को करने का इच्छुक होना
English Meaning: To be excited to do something
📝 Sentence Example:"I feel like going to school."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Feel like -> 'मन कर रहा है' (I feel like eating pizza)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Figure out"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: समझ पाना
English Meaning: To understand
📝 Sentence Example:"I am unable to figure out the meaning of his ambiguous statement."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Figure + out -> दिमाग लगा कर किसी गणित (Figure) का हल 'समझना' (out)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Fish for"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: पाने का प्रयास करना (सूचना इत्यादि)
English Meaning: To seek something by probing
📝 Sentence Example:"The reporter tried to fish for some information."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Fish -> जैसे पानी में से मछली (Fish) ढूँढ़कर निकालते हैं, वैसे ही छुपी हुई जानकारी निकालना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Fly open"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: अचानक खुल जाना
English Meaning: To open suddenly
📝 Sentence Example:"The doors flew open when the storm came."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Fly + Open -> हवा के झोंके से दरवाज़ा 'उड़कर' (Fly) अचानक खुल गया।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Follow up"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: करना (किसी कॉज/मकसद को पूरा करने हेतु)
English Meaning: To pursue
📝 Sentence Example:"You must follow up this routine for better result."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Follow + Up -> किसी काम के पीछे लगे (Follow) रहना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Gain on"?
options: To come close to someone or something that you are chasing
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: नजदीक आना (उसके, जिसे पाने के प्रयासरत हो)
English Meaning: To come close to someone or something that you are chasing
📝 Sentence Example:"I am gaining on them in my business. Soon I will leave them behind."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Gain -> रेस में किसी के पीछे दौड़कर दूरी कम (Gain) कर लेना (नज़दीक आना)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Get about/around"?
options: To do something wrong without getting caught
Spread, move around or be socially active
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: फैल जाना, इधर-उधर घूमना या सामाजिक रूप से सजग होना
English Meaning: Spread, move around or be socially active
📝 Sentence Example:"Good news about upcoming vacancies is getting about."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Get + Around -> खबर का हर जगह (Around) घूम-घूम कर 'फैल जाना'।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Get at"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: समझ जाना, तक पहुँचना
English Meaning: to understand, to reach successfully
📝 Sentence Example:"I am doing my best to get at the truth."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Get + At -> सच्चाई 'तक' (At) पहुँच जाना (समझ जाना)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Get away with"?
options: To do something wrong or illegal without getting caught or punished
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: कोई गलत काम करना और पकड़े जाने या सजा से बच जाना
English Meaning: To do something wrong or illegal without getting caught or punished
📝 Sentence Example:"The thieves got away with all my belongings."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Get + Away -> गलत काम करके भी आराम से 'दूर' (Away) भाग जाना (बच जाना)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Get back"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: लौटना
English Meaning: To return
📝 Sentence Example:"I will get back to you soon."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Get + Back -> वापस (Back) आना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Get along"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: अच्छा संबंध होना
English Meaning: have smooth relations
📝 Sentence Example:"He and his wife are not getting along well these days."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Get + Along -> 'साथ-साथ' (Along) चलना मतलब अच्छे सम्बंध होना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Get down"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: किसी कार्य के तरफ ध्यान लगाना
English Meaning: To direct attention towards something
📝 Sentence Example:"Please get down to your work."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Get + Down -> अपने काम पर ध्यान टिका (Down) कर लग जाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Get off"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: काम से आधिकारिक अवकाश मिलना
English Meaning: To leave work with permission
📝 Sentence Example:"You can get an off tomorrow."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Get + Off -> ड्यूटी से 'Off' (छुट्टी) मिल जाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Get on"?
options: To make progress, to be on harmonious terms
To be excited to do something
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: प्रगति करना, अच्छा संबंध होना
English Meaning: To make progress, to be on harmonious terms
📝 Sentence Example:"He gets on well with all his neighbours."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Get + On -> ज़िंदगी की गाड़ी 'ऑन' (On) रखना (प्रगति करना)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Get over"?
options: To do something wrong without getting caught
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: पार पाना/ उबर जाना
English Meaning: To overcome
📝 Sentence Example:"Finally I got over the difficulties and court cases."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Get + Over -> बीमारी या मुश्किल के 'ऊपर' (Over) से छलांग लगा कर उबर जाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Get rid of"?
options: To start or continue to do something
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: छुटकारा पाना
English Meaning: To dispose of/to leave
📝 Sentence Example:"I want to get rid of my bad habits."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Rid -> किसी गंदी आदत से खुद को Rid (मुक्त) कर लेना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Get round (a problem)"?
options: To evade or avoid a problem
To finish or assist in finishing
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: किसी समस्या से बचने के लिए रास्ता ढूंढ लेना
English Meaning: To evade or avoid a problem
📝 Sentence Example:"He will get round your problems in some way or the other."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Round -> प्रॉब्लम का सामना करने के बजाय 'गोल घूम' (Round) कर निकल जाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Get round (someone)"?
options: To persuade someone to do what you want
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: किसी को कुछ करने के लिए मना लेना
English Meaning: To persuade someone to do what you want
📝 Sentence Example:"You will have to get them round to join your team."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Get + Round -> मीठी बातें करके किसी को अपनी बातों में 'घुमा' (Round) कर मना लेना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Get through"?
options: To finish or assist in finishing
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: कोई कार्य पूरा करना या पूरा कराने में सहायता करना
English Meaning: To finish or assist in finishing
📝 Sentence Example:"If you work hard, you will get through this task in a week."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Through -> मुश्किल काम के 'आर-पार' (Through) हो जाना (पूरा कर लेना)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Get up"?
options: To start or continue to do something
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: जागना
English Meaning: to wake up
📝 Sentence Example:"I get up at 6 am everyday."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Get + Up -> सुबह बिस्तर से 'ऊपर' (Up) उठना (जागना)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Give away"?
options: To attack, to try to attain
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: बाँटना
English Meaning: To distribute
📝 Sentence Example:"The Chief guest gave away the prizes."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Give + Away -> चीज़ें 'दे' (Give) कर खुद से 'दूर' (Away) कर देना मतलब बाँट देना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Give in"?
options: To agree, to surrender, to submit
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: मान जाना, समर्पण कर देना, सौंपना
English Meaning: To agree, to surrender, to submit
📝 Sentence Example:"The daughter-in-law gave in to her in-laws' demands."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Give + In -> दबाव में 'अंदर' (In) आकर हार मान लेना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Give up"?
options: To leave, to stop doing something/to yield
To start or continue to do something
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: छोड़ देना, त्याग देना, हार मान जाना
English Meaning: To leave, to stop doing something/to yield
📝 Sentence Example:"She has given up smoking."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Give + Up -> हिम्मत 'ऊपर' (Up) वाले पर छोड़कर त्याग देना (हार मानना)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Go ahead"?
options: To start or continue to do something
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: किसी कार्य को शुरू करना या जारी रखना
English Meaning: To start or continue to do something
📝 Sentence Example:"Go ahead with your demands."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Go + Ahead -> काम में 'आगे' (Ahead) बढ़ते जाओ।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Go along"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: सहयोग देना
English Meaning: To cooperate
📝 Sentence Example:"I will go along with them on this issue."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Go + Along -> किसी के 'साथ' (Along) चलना मतलब सहयोग देना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Go at"?
options: To attack, to try to attain
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: हमला करना (पूरे उर्जा के साथ)
English Meaning: to attack especially with energy
📝 Sentence Example:"The bull went at the audience and this led to stampede."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Go + At -> सांड (Bull) की तरह सीधे किसी पर 'जाना' (Go at) मतलब हमला करना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Go back on"?
options: To start or continue to do something
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: वादे से मुकर जाना
English Meaning: To break a promise
📝 Sentence Example:"Why did you go back on your promise?"
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Go + Back -> जो बोला था उस बात से 'पीछे' (Back) हट जाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Go by"?
options: To attack, to try to attain
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: नियमानुसार कार्य करना, गुजरना (समय इत्यादि का)
English Meaning: To work accordingly
📝 Sentence Example:"(1) We should go by the traffic rules. (2) Time went by."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Go + By -> रूल्स के 'अनुसार' (By) चलना या समय का 'गुज़रना'।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Go down"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: विश्वास करना/ स्वीकार करना
English Meaning: To be accepted
📝 Sentence Example:"The theory of evolution did not go down well initially."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Go + Down -> गले के 'नीचे' (Down) उतरना (बात का हज़म/स्वीकार होना)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Go down in history"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: इतिहास में नाम दर्ज कराना
English Meaning: To get registered in history
📝 Sentence Example:"Ashok went down in History due to his religious work."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:History -> इतिहास के पन्नों में दर्ज़ हो जाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Go for"?
options: To attack, to try to attain, to choose
To start or continue to do something
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: आक्रमण करना, पाने की कोशिश करना या चुनना
English Meaning: To attack, to try to attain, to choose
📝 Sentence Example:"(1) I will go for this dress. (2) If you want it, go for it."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Go + For -> मुझे तो बस 'यही चाहिए' (I'll go for it)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Go off"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: फटना (बम का)/बन्दूक से गोली छूटना
English Meaning: explode
📝 Sentence Example:"The bomb went off and people ran helter-skelter."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Off -> बम के फटने से आवाज़ 'ऑफ' (Off) हो गई (विस्फोट)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Go on"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: जारी रखना
English Meaning: To continue doing something
📝 Sentence Example:"She went on reading the book."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Go + On -> काम को 'ऑन' (On) रखना (जारी रखना)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Go over"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: स्वीकार होना
English Meaning: To gain acceptance
📝 Sentence Example:"The film went over well."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Go + Over -> फिल्म पब्लिक के ऊपर (Over) से अच्छे से गुज़री (Hit हो गई/स्वीकार हो गई)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Go through"?
options: To pass through a time, to read
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: किसी दौर से गुजरना, पढ़ना
English Meaning: To pass through a time, to read
📝 Sentence Example:"Let me go through this book."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Through -> किताब के पन्नों के 'आर-पार' (Through) जाना मतलब उसे पढ़ना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Go up"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: बढ़ना
English Meaning: Increase
📝 Sentence Example:"Price of foodgrains went up due to famine."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Go + Up -> दाम का ग्राफ 'ऊपर' (Up) जाना मतलब बढ़ना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Go with"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: चुनना
English Meaning: To select or choose
📝 Sentence Example:"I cannot go with this brand."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Go + With -> मैं इस रंग के 'साथ' (With) जाऊँगा (मतलब उसे चुनना)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Hear of"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: समाचार मिलना
English Meaning: To get the news about
📝 Sentence Example:"I haven't heard of any such haunted house."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Hear -> किसी भूतिया घर के बारे में 'सुनना' (Hear) यानी खबर मिलना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Hit on/upon"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: अचानक दिमाग में आना
English Meaning: To come to mind suddenly
📝 Sentence Example:"An idea hit upon me when I was reading the story."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Hit -> कोई कमाल का आईडिया एकदम से दिमाग में 'हिट' (Hit) करना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Hold back"?
options: To retain in one's possession, to restrain oneself
To maintain one's grip, to continue
To pursue successfully by diligent searching
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: (व्यक्त करने) से रोकना, खुद को रोकना किसी कार्य से
English Meaning: To retain in one's possession, to restrain oneself
📝 Sentence Example:"Please hold back your emotions."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Hold + Back -> अपने आंसुओं या गुस्से को 'पीछे' (Back) रोक कर (Hold) रखना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Hold down"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: रोकना, नियंत्रित करना
English Meaning: To prevent, to limit
📝 Sentence Example:"The militants were held down by the Indian army."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Hold + Down -> दुश्मन को ज़मीन पर 'दबा' (Down) कर रोक (Hold) लेना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Hold on"?
options: To maintain one's grip, to continue to do something despite difficulties, to wait
To draw conclusion in a hurry
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: पकड़कर रखना, जारी रखना (कठिनाई के बावजूद), इंतजार करना
English Meaning: To maintain one's grip, to continue to do something despite difficulties, to wait for something wanted or requested.
📝 Sentence Example:"Please hold on while we transfer your call to our executive."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Hold -> फोन पर 'होल्ड' करना मतलब थोड़ा इंतज़ार करना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Hold with"?
options: To pursue successfully by diligent searching
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: सहमत होना
English Meaning: Approve of/agree with
📝 Sentence Example:"I cannot hold with them on this matter."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Hold + With -> मैं तुम्हारे विचारों के 'साथ' (With) खड़ा (Hold) हूँ।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Hunt down"?
options: To pursue successfully by diligent searching and chasing
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: खोज निकालना
English Meaning: To pursue successfully by diligent searching and chasing.
📝 Sentence Example:"The militants were hunted down at the border."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Hunt -> आतंकवादियों का शिकार (Hunt) करके उन्हें ढूँढ़ निकालना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Hush up"?
options: To draw conclusion in a hurry
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: छिपाना
English Meaning: To hide
📝 Sentence Example:"They hushed up this scam."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Hush -> 'हश!' (चुप रहो) कहकर किसी घोटाले को छुपाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Impress (idea) on"?
options: To convince someone or impart a strong impression in the mind of someone
To pursue successfully by diligent searching
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: छाप छोड़ना (कोई बात का किसी व्यक्ति के दिमाग पर)
English Meaning: To convince someone or impart a strong impression in the mind of someone
📝 Sentence Example:"She can impress upon the clients easily."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Impress -> अपनी बातों से सामने वाले के दिमाग पर गहरा असर (Impression) डालना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Iron out"?
options: To draw conclusion in a hurry
solution:

📝 Sentence Example:"Internet makes for better communication."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Make + For -> इन्टरनेट ने अच्छे कम्युनिकेशन को 'संभव' (Possible) बना दिया है।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Make of"?
options: To use to the greatest advantage
Invent something like excuse or story
To understand, to produce or construct from
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: अभिप्राय को समझना, से बना होना
English Meaning: To understand, to produce or construct from
📝 Sentence Example:"What do you make of this news?"
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Make + Of -> तुम इस न्यूज़ से क्या 'मतलब' (Understand) निकालते हो?

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Make off"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: किसी चीज को लेकर भाग निकलना
English Meaning: To run away with
📝 Sentence Example:"He made off with all my money."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Make + Off -> वो मेरे सारे पैसे लेकर 'रफूचक्कर' (Off) हो गया।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Make out"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: समझना
English Meaning: To understand
📝 Sentence Example:"I cannot make out the head or tail of your statement."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Make + Out -> मैं तुम्हारी बात का सिर-पैर 'समझ' (Make out) नहीं पा रहा हूँ।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Make over"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: परिवर्तित
English Meaning: convert, redo, renovate
📝 Sentence Example:"This place needs a complete makeover."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Makeover -> इस जगह को एक कम्पलीट 'मेकओवर' (नवीनीकरण/Renovation) की ज़रूरत है।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Make the most of"?
options: To use to the greatest advantage
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: पूरा-पूरा लाभ उठाना
English Meaning: To use to the greatest advantage
📝 Sentence Example:"We will make the most of this opportunity."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Most -> इस मौके का 'सबसे ज़्यादा' (Most) फायदा उठाएंगे।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Make up"?
options: Invent something like excuse or story/ to compensate for
To understand, to produce or construct from
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: बनाना/रचना (कहानी/बहाने इत्यादि) / क्षतिपूर्ति करना
English Meaning: Invent something like excuse or story/ to compensate for
📝 Sentence Example:"(1) He made up an excuse for coming late. (2) They paid him... to make up for the loss."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Make + Up -> (1) लेट आने पर बहाना 'बनाना' (Invent). (2) नुकसान की 'भरपाई' (Compensate) करना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Make up one's mind"?
options: To use to the greatest advantage
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: निर्णय कर लेना
English Meaning: Determine
📝 Sentence Example:"You will have to make up your mind whether you want to accept the offer or not."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Mind -> अपने 'दिमाग' को पक्का कर लो (निर्णय ले लो) कि ऑफर लेना है या नहीं।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Meet with"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: अनुभव करना (किसी घटना का)
English Meaning: To experience or undergo
📝 Sentence Example:"He met with an accident."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Meet + With -> उसका एक एक्सीडेंट के 'साथ' (With) सामना (Meet) हो गया (दुर्घटना हुई)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "On the make"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: बनने की क्रिया में
English Meaning: In the process of forming
📝 Sentence Example:"Seeing this child artist, I can say that a very good actor is on the make."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Make -> ये बच्चा अभी 'बनने' (Make) की प्रोसेस में है, आगे बड़ा एक्टर बनेगा।
